title: 이자제한법 제2조제1항의 최고이자율에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:0:0:00001:part:1/1
full_text: The maximum interest rate under a contract for a loan of money pursuant to Article 2 (1) of the Interest Limitation Act shall be 20 percent per annum. <Amended on June 11, 2014; November 7, 2017; and April 6, 2021.>
